title: Hover a setting for help
caption: Hover any setting name on Server Settings to see what it does and its default value.

title: Compare frameworks
caption: Hover a framework card on Install & Mods to read what it changes before you switch.

title: Compact sidebar labels
caption: With the sidebar collapsed to icons, hover an icon to see which page it opens.

title: Console shortcuts
caption: Hover the console search arrows to see their keyboard shortcuts, like Shift+F3 for the previous match.

title: Command autocomplete
caption: Start typing in the console box and pick a command from the list; each one shows its default and a short description.

title: Command library
caption: Open Console > Commands, search 2,600+ Rust and Carbon commands and press Use to put one in the console box.

title: Settings presets
caption: On Server Settings > Presets, pick a starter like 5x, check its values and press Apply.

title: Pick a game mode
caption: On Server Settings > World & map, choose the game mode from the server's own list.

title: Live browser preview
caption: Type your server name, description and website on Server Identity and watch the browser preview update as you type.

title: Find plugins on uMod
caption: On Plugins > uMod, search by name or tag, sort the results and install a plugin with one click.

title: Automation templates
caption: Press New task on Automation and start from a template such as a daily restart or a nightly backup.

title: Switch and add servers
caption: Click the server card at the top of the sidebar to switch servers or add, import and edit them.

title: New server: name and icon
caption: The New server wizard starts with a name, an icon and a colour, previewed as it will look in the sidebar.

title: New server: framework
caption: In step 3 of the wizard, choose Vanilla, Carbon or Oxide; it installs together with the server.
